players.product: silicon-photonics foundry services (PH18 SiPho platform) + SiGe drivers/TIAs

quarterly_data.signal: 6-K interim financial statements and MD&A: H1 2026 revenue was $873.7 million versus $730.2 million, an increase of about 19.6% that management attributes mostly to a higher average selling price from a different product mix (especially more SiPho-related products shipped) and a higher quantity of products shipped; H1 investments in property and equipment, net, were $343.0 million, and operating cash flow of $686.9 million included a $282.6 million increase in customers' advances. Under the March 25, 2026 framework agreement with NTCJ, Tower's new wholly owned Japanese subsidiary (TSJPN) will own all Fab 7 (300mm) manufacturing production tools and manage all Fab 7 operations, employees and business activities, while the Tonami fab remains in TPSCo, which becomes a wholly owned subsidiary of NTCJ.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue $873.7 million (about 19.6% increase); H1 capex $343.0 million; customers' advances increase $282.6 million
